original.statement: In 3.0 the system-level ignoreDifferences customizations also apply to ignoring resource updates by default (ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates now true); set it to false in argocd-cm resource.compareoptions to keep the v2 behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-63314a5fae82] says that in 3.0, system-level `ignoreDifferences` customizations now also ignore resource updates by default. It also says that setting `ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates` to false under `resource.compareoptions` in the argocd-cm ConfigMap keeps the v2 default. So the v2 default was false and the new default is true, which makes this a default change for that nested config key.
